_about: The one place GenClass plans are defined. telemetry-worker/src/plans.ts imports this file (limits, entitlements, Stripe lookup keys, the billing page) and genclass.dev's site reads it (the pricing page). Two plans: Free and Enterprise. Free has the runtime, its on-device model, the dashboard, analytics, export and forwarding with 90 days of history, and your own classifier, which a person from GenClass trains when you email the contact address. Enterprise is agreed by email: a null monthly price means the plan is not sold on the site, and an account gets it from GenClass's own grant (grant_plan, accounts.comp_until, set by hand to the end of the agreement). No plan is sold on Stripe Checkout today (the Individual plan, US$29 a month, ended on 2026-10-22); the worker's Stripe code and scripts/stripe-setup.mjs still sell any plan given a monthly price above 0, its stripe_lookup_keys and a stripe_tax_code. Prices are US cents; a null yearly price means no yearly option. limits.apps null means no plan limit (the worker still caps an account at 200 apps against abuse). There is no trial. Feature lines with available false are shown as coming next. managed_payments true would sell a plan through Stripe Managed Payments (only for fully automated digital products; telemetry-worker/README.md, Paid plans).
footer: Questions about your classifier, Enterprise, self-hosting or invoices? Email mehar@daybot.ca.

plans.summary: The open-source runtime, its on-device model, the dashboard and your own classifier, for every app.

features.text: The open-source runtime (Apache-2.0) with every mode: observe, guard and heal
Your own classifier: we train a GenClass model on your app's traffic, bug reports or labelled examples and ship it as a private model your runtime loads
The dashboard for every app: what GenClass found, on which pages, and what it did
Full data export: every event GenClass received for your apps, as JSONL or CSV, by download or API
Forward detections to Sentry, PostHog, Datadog, Slack or a signed webhook
Interaction analytics: clicks, scrolls and time on page (coming next)
Private mode: run the open-source collector on your own Cloudflare account, so your data never passes through us
Email mehar@daybot.ca to start your classifier
